capabilities: Render a 3x3 alignment grid from an alignmenttracker code block
Increment axis counters as players commit Lawful, Chaotic, Good, or Evil acts
Review accumulated alignment dots per player over time
disambiguation: Tracks D&D character moral alignment, not text or paragraph alignment.
extras: README labels the plugin a POC (proof of concept) and its results section appears to rely on images not present in the text.
motivation: The author disagrees with assigning alignment upfront and instead marks each action that reads as Lawful, Chaotic, Good, or Evil, then reviews the tables to see where players stand.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record and visualize how a D&D character's alignment shifts based on their actions over a campaign.

relations.evidence: I recommend creating a template with the Templater plugin using the following content

summary: D&D alignment tracker that renders a 3x3 Lawful-Chaotic / Good-Evil grid from counters in an alignmenttracker code block.
